title: UC-01 · Planned failover
subtitle: Move the primary role to the other zone for maintenance - no acknowledged transaction lost

clocks.label: Write interruption
clocks.explain: From the AG going offline on {primary} to the application's first commit on {secondary}

clocks.label: Failback interruption
clocks.explain: From the AG going offline on {secondary} to the application's first commit back on {primary}

phases.label: Pre-check
phases.explain: Checking both nodes are up, {secondary} is SYNCHRONOUS and every database SYNCHRONIZED

phases.label: Start application
phases.explain: An application writer commits a ledger row every 0.2 s on {primary} ({primaryDomain})

phases.label: Warm-up
phases.explain: Normal operation: every commit is hardened on {secondary} ({secondaryDomain}) before it is acknowledged

phases.label: Synchronize
phases.explain: Commits now wait for {secondary}; waiting until every database is SYNCHRONIZED there

phases.label: AG offline
phases.explain: Taking the AG offline on {primary}: writes stop so nothing can be committed during the swap

phases.label: Promote
phases.explain: {secondary} becomes primary - it already has every committed transaction

phases.label: Demote
phases.explain: {primary} becomes the secondary and starts receiving {secondary}'s changes

phases.label: App reconnects
phases.explain: The application retries and commits on {secondary} by itself - this stops the clock

phases.label: Observe
phases.explain: Watching throughput and replication on the new primary {secondary}

phases.label: Verify
phases.explain: Every acknowledged commit in the ledger of {secondary}, {primary} SYNCHRONIZED as its secondary

phases.label: Synchronize
phases.explain: Waiting until every database is SYNCHRONIZED on {primary}

metrics.label: Write interruption
metrics.explain: Application view: last commit on {primary} -> first commit on {secondary}

metrics.label: Lost transactions
metrics.explain: Acknowledged commits missing from the new primary's ledger

metrics.label: Throughput
metrics.explain: Commits the application gets acknowledged per second, now

metrics.label: Role swap took
metrics.explain: AG offline -> promoted -> old primary demoted and resumed

metrics.label: Failed attempts
metrics.explain: Errors the application got and retried (AG offline, read-only secondary)

charts.label: Application throughput
charts.explain: Drops to 0 while the roles change, then resumes on the new primary

charts.label: Failed attempts
charts.explain: Errors the application retries during the swap

charts.label: Slowest commit
charts.explain: Synchronous commit: each commit waits for the secondary

criteria.label: Write interruption measured from the application's side
The application reconnected to {secondary} by itself
{secondary} primary, databases online, application writing to it
